title: Auto hinattiin kolme kertaa parin viikon sisään
subtitle: Review lesson — the towing saga, three-quarters checkpoint

blocks.text: Thirty lessons in. Lessons 26-29 gave you the object case system, questions, adjective agreement, and reported speech — dense, structural material. Time to let it settle into one long, real complaint: the towing saga first glimpsed back in Lesson 14.

items.fi: Sain {ajan|grammar|accusative object|an appointment}, sain hyvää {palvelua|grammar|partitive object|service}.

blocks.text: Now — the towing saga, fully annotated

blocks.title: Read it once unaided first
blocks.text: This review escalates across several sentences — towing, a false repair claim, a breakdown, and a refusal to take responsibility. It's one of the angriest, most detailed complaints in the corpus. Try it cold before checking the breakdown.

blocks.content: Autoni {hinattiin|grammar|passive past|was towed} kolme {kertaa|grammar|partitive after number|times} parin viikon sisään tänne, lupasivat tutkia huolella ja palauttivat auton {korjattuna|grammar|essive|as fixed} kolmesti.

Auto hajosi jo kotimatkalla, mutta eivät palauttaneet rahoja tai kantaneet vastuuta virheistä, {jotka|grammar|relative pronoun, plural|that} {myönsivät|word|verb|admitted} {tehneensä|grammar|referative construction|having done}.

{Kun|grammar|conjunction|when} auto vietiin puolueettomalle korjaamolle, paljastui, {että|grammar|conjunction|that} auton moottori {oli|grammar|pluperfect|had been} pysyvästi vaurioitunut väärän diagnoosin vuoksi, ja olin maksanut tälle firmalle yli 1000 euroa turhaan.

blocks.title: A handful of bonus words in this text
blocks.text: Sisään here means 'within' (parin viikon sisään, 'within a couple of weeks'), not the illative 'into' from Lesson 7 — same word, different job depending on context. Kolmesti means 'three times', a slightly more formal cousin of kolme kertaa (Lesson 19). Puolueeton means 'impartial/independent' — puolue (side/party) + -ton (a 'without' suffix you'll formally meet later, but can already guess: 'without a side' = neutral).

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How many times was the car towed?

lines.speaker: B
lines.fi: Kolme kertaa parin viikon sisään. Palauttivat sen aina korjattuna, mutta se hajosi joka kerta.
lines.en: Three times within a couple of weeks. They always returned it as fixed, but it broke down every time.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What was revealed at the independent repair shop?

lines.speaker: B
lines.fi: Että moottori oli pysyvästi vaurioitunut, ja olin maksanut yli 1000 euroa täysin turhaan.
lines.en: That the engine had been permanently damaged, and I had paid over 1000 euros for absolutely nothing.

rows.en: three times (formal cousin of kolme kertaa)

blocks.title: What you now own after thirty lessons
items: you can read the full towing saga — one of the corpus's longest, angriest complaints — start to finish
you can trace the referative construction (tehneensä) back to its source, three lessons after first meeting it
you can spot the pluperfect (oli vaurioitunut) doing the reveal work you named in Lesson 24
you're ready for the final stretch of lessons, covering remaining verb forms and the finer points of style
